title: Machine problem
asOf: From this tablet, as of {time}: the network is down.

banner.locked: {machine} is marked do not use (unsafe): do not work on it until a technician signs it safe.
banner.doNotUse: {machine} is set do-not-use by the office: do not work on it.
banner.maintenance: {machine} is being worked on by maintenance.
banner.blocked: Every machine at this station is do-not-use: the station takes no scans until one is signed safe.

which.scanHint: The QR tag on the machine, or tap one of this station's machines below.

scanned.notFound: No machine of this site has the tag {code}. Check the tag, or tap the machine below.
scanned.offline: {code} is not on this tablet and the network is down. Tap the machine below, or try again when the network is back.
scanned.unavailable: The factory server does not answer for {code}. Try again in a minute.

which.none: No machine is registered at this station. Scan the machine's tag.
which.noStationBody: Scan the machine's tag to report its problem.

camera.error: The camera did not start. Allow it in Android, or use the scanner.

held.noReport: Your role here does not report machine problems. Ask your team leader.
held.machineFirst: Scan or tap the machine first.
held.retired: This machine is retired: its tag no longer reports problems.
held.pickOrWords: Tap what is wrong, or say it in a few words.
held.words: Say in a few words what is wrong.
held.noWork: Only a maintenance technician works on jobs.
held.notYours: This job is given to another technician: the office reassigns it.
held.offline: Needs the network: try again when the tablet is back online.
held.after: Tap how the machine is now.
held.signFirst: Running only once a technician has signed the machine safe.
held.noSign: Only a technician signs a machine safe again.
held.photo: Photos from the tablet come later: the office can add one to the request.

symptom.title: What is wrong?
symptom.offline: The network is down: the report is saved on this tablet and sent when it is back.
symptom.wordsOrPick: Or say it in a few words
symptom.wordsHint: What you see or hear. Never a person's name.
symptom.unsafeBySymptom: This symptom locks the machine by itself.
symptom.unsafeBody: {machine} will be marked do not use at once: nobody may work on it until a technician signs it safe.
symptom.saysWords: Say it in a few words
symptom.none: No symptoms are set up for this machine: say in a few words what is wrong.

sent.title: Reported: {machine}
sent.waits: Saved on this tablet: maintenance learns of it when the network is back. If it is urgent or dangerous, tell your team leader now.
sent.unsafeNext: Do not use the machine. A technician checks it and signs it safe.
sent.downNext: The machine shows as down until maintenance has looked at it.
sent.refusedTitle: Maintenance could not take this report
sent.refusedFix: Open the queue to see why, then report it again.

jobs.title: My jobs
jobs.emptyBody: Jobs given to you or to nobody show here, the most urgent first.

done.handedBack: {job} handed back: the office closes it.

job.notYours: This job is given to another technician: you can read it, the office reassigns it.
job.lastNone: No earlier job on this machine.
job.repeat: {count} problems in the last 30 days: look for the cause.

handBack.title: Hand back {job} · {machine}
handBack.words: What you did, in a few words
handBack.wordsHint: The office reads it on the job. Needed for Other.
handBack.retiredNote: The machine stays do-not-use; the office retires it when it closes the job.

sign.title: Sign {machine} safe
sign.meaning: You confirm that you checked the machine and that it may be used again.
sign.checkedHint: For example: guard refitted and tested, electrics checked.
sign.after: How is the machine after the check?
sign.law: A machine marked unsafe is used again only after a technician's check (D.Lgs. 81/2008 art. 71).

fact.photosValue_one: {count} photo: open the request in the office
fact.photosValue_other: {count} photos: open the request in the office

RETIRED.message: This machine is retired: its tag no longer reports problems.
RETIRED.fix: Scan the machine that stands at the station now, or ask the office.

SYMPTOM_INACTIVE.message: This symptom is no longer offered.
SYMPTOM_INACTIVE.fix: Pick another symptom, or Other with a few words.

SYMPTOM_OTHER_CLASS.message: This symptom is for another kind of machine.
SYMPTOM_OTHER_CLASS.fix: Pick a symptom shown for this machine.

DETAIL_NEEDED.message: Say in a few words what is wrong.
DETAIL_NEEDED.fix: Write what you see or hear, then report again.

NO_REPORTER.message: This tablet cannot say who reports.
NO_REPORTER.fix: Ask the office to set up the station of this tablet.

LOCKED_UNSAFE.message: The machine is still locked as unsafe.
LOCKED_UNSAFE.fix: A technician signs it safe first.

NOT_UNSAFE.message: This problem was not reported unsafe: there is nothing to sign.

SIGNED_ALREADY.message: This problem is signed safe already.

MOVE_NOT_ALLOWED.message: The job has changed meanwhile: this step is not possible now.
MOVE_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Go back to My jobs and open it again.

NOT_YOUR_JOB.message: This job is given to another technician.
NOT_YOUR_JOB.fix: Work the jobs given to you or to nobody; the office reassigns it.
